title: pdoom live source inventory
scope: Prioritized source families for an AI risk, progress and timeline evidence dataset. Not an exhaustive census and not collected observations.

definitions.opened-primary: Official page, report, repository or dataset page inspected; underlying data downloads may remain unverified.
definitions.documentation-only: Official access or schema documentation inspected; actual data access not established.
definitions.explicit-license: A license was verified only for the artifact identified in rights_notes. It may include noncommercial or share-alike restrictions.
definitions.terms-restricted: Material access or intended-use restrictions were verified; not admitted for collection by this inventory.
definitions.unknown: Reuse scope was not established. This is a review task, not proof that reuse is forbidden.
definitions.P0: Highest analytical value and first clearance/acquisition attention, not automatic permission.
definitions.P1: Important expansion candidate after core work.
definitions.candidate_not_collected: Research identified the source. No corpus collection or integration is claimed.
definitions.data_url: Verified data file, repository, dataset page or official export entry point, as explained by access_method.

records.name: Epoch AI: AI models
records.access_method: Public CSV; methodology and field documentation linked from primary page
records.available_content: Model identities, dates, institutions, country, training compute, parameters, data size, estimated training cost and uncertainty labels.
records.historical_coverage: Models from 1950 onward; latest listed all-model CSV update 2026-10-05.
records.rights_notes: Primary page explicitly applies CC BY 4.0 to Epoch data; preserve source and author attribution.
records.next_action: Freeze a dated CSV snapshot, retain entry-level references and confidence labels, and resolve model-family/version identifiers.
records.caveats: Publisher is non-China but dataset includes China. Estimated compute is not measured compute; missing values and selection bias matter.

records.name: Epoch AI: machine-learning hardware
records.access_method: Public CSV and hardware documentation
records.available_content: Accelerator specifications, numeric precision performance, memory, release timing and selected release prices.
records.historical_coverage: Historical hardware releases; exact earliest observation not checked. Listed CSV update 2026-10-01.
records.rights_notes: Dataset page explicitly grants CC BY 4.0 reuse.
records.next_action: Snapshot CSV, distinguish dense/sparse and precision-specific FLOP measures, and separate list/release price from rental cost.
records.caveats: Specifications are theoretical peaks. Missing fields are common; no inference that all chips were deployed or available to a given lab.

records.name: Epoch AI: AI data centers
records.access_method: Public ZIP of CSV tables documented on source page
records.available_content: Facility capacity, construction timelines, chip quantities and related cooling/chip-type tables.
records.historical_coverage: Mostly facilities operational from 2024 onward plus selected earlier exceptions and under-construction projects; listed update 2026-10-05.
records.rights_notes: Dataset page explicitly grants CC BY 4.0 reuse.
records.next_action: Separate operational, under-construction and projected capacity; preserve observation date and underlying permits/satellite references.
records.caveats: US-heavy coverage is acknowledged by publisher. Announced/planned capacity is not available training compute; estimates can change.

records.name: METR: task-completion time horizons
records.access_method: Public repository with JSONL runs and reproducible analysis; headline page links raw data
records.available_content: Task-level scores, human-duration estimates, model aliases, weighting, p50/p80 horizons and bootstrap analysis.
records.historical_coverage: TH 1.0 covers models from 2019 through November 2025; TH 1.1 extends task suite; headline last updated May 8, 2026.
records.rights_notes: README references a LICENSE file but no effective data-license text was verified in this pass. Public availability does not establish redistribution permission.
records.next_action: Resolve data rights, pin repository commit, and ingest TH versions separately with scaffold, task and uncertainty metadata.
records.caveats: Software/ML/cyber tasks are not all work. Page warns measurements above 16 hours are unreliable; coverage is incomplete and evaluations lag releases.

records.name: LiveBench: judgments, answers and versioned benchmark data
records.access_method: Official GitHub links public Hugging Face datasets and JSONL download scripts
records.available_content: Versioned questions, model answers, objective judgments, category/task scores and release changelog.
records.historical_coverage: Public releases since 2024; complete result/benchmark-version coverage must be enumerated.
records.rights_notes: Repository has Apache 2.0 text inherited from FastChat; separate model-judgment data license was not displayed on the inspected dataset page. Audit per-artifact terms.
records.next_action: Verify judgment and question licenses, enumerate dataset revisions, then join model/release/configuration to scores.
records.caveats: Do not compare scores across changing question releases without adjustment. README notes that not all questions from the stated current release are public.

records.name: Stanford CRFM: HELM results and framework
records.access_method: Public framework, leaderboard and documentation; exact result export endpoint not verified
records.available_content: Scenario definitions, standardized metrics, leaderboard comparisons and per-prompt inspection capabilities.
records.historical_coverage: Historical suites since 2022; entered maintenance mode June 1, 2026.
records.rights_notes: Framework is Apache 2.0; this does not automatically license upstream datasets or every hosted output.
records.next_action: Treat as historical/reproducibility source; read maintenance policy and verify versioned result export plus per-scenario licenses.
records.caveats: No assumption of continued live model coverage. Suites and upstream benchmark rights differ.

records.name: SWE-bench: submission results and artifact registry
records.access_method: Public submission metadata/results repository; linked submitter repositories or legacy S3 artifacts
records.available_content: Submission dates, model/scaffold descriptions, result summaries, resolved-instance IDs and pointers to predictions/logs.
records.historical_coverage: Submissions since 2023; storage and submission policies changed during 2025–2026.
records.rights_notes: No blanket license for all submission artifacts was verified. Main benchmark code license is not sufficient for third-party repositories.
records.next_action: Pin entry commit, resolve each assets block, check artifact rights and join score with scaffold, budget, split and model checkpoint.
records.caveats: Current repository explicitly holds entries rather than all artifacts. Post-November-2025 eligibility changes and public benchmark contamination affect comparisons.

records.name: MLCommons: MLPerf training results
records.access_method: Public versioned result repositories; one concrete training release verified
records.available_content: Submitted system configurations, hardware/software stack, logs and training-to-target benchmark measurements.

records.rights_notes: Inspected repository declares Apache 2.0; retain notices and check third-party components and MLPerf result-use rules.
records.next_action: Enumerate official release repositories and freeze one; normalize closed/open divisions and benchmark versions.
records.caveats: Training benchmark speed is not frontier capability or installed compute. Vendor submissions are selected and heavily optimized.

records.name: ARC Prize: ARC-AGI evaluations and public tasks
records.access_method: Public leaderboard and Apache-licensed public task repository
records.available_content: Cost/performance comparisons, test-policy context and ARC-AGI-2 public task JSON.
records.historical_coverage: ARC benchmark generations differ; verified public ARC-AGI-2 task release and current multi-generation leaderboard.
records.rights_notes: Apache 2.0 verified for ARC-AGI-2 repository; do not assume it also licenses every leaderboard submission or private evaluation set.
records.next_action: Freeze benchmark generation and public-task commit; separately obtain score export rights and mark preview/private-test results.
records.caveats: Task data is not a result time series. ARC-AGI-3 is interactive and must not be concatenated with earlier scores; costs and test-time budgets are essential.

records.name: AI Impacts: Expert Survey on Progress in AI
records.access_method: Official wiki links cleaned anonymized response sheet; survey papers and questionnaires
records.available_content: Respondent-level anonymized forecasts, question wording, framing, AI milestones and outcome/risk responses.

records.rights_notes: Homepage applies CC0 to research pages, explicitly excluding blog posts. Scope of separately hosted response sheet requires confirmation.
records.next_action: Verify response-file rights, export approved anonymized fields, and preserve question wording, survey wave, framing and respondent population.
records.caveats: Non-response and sampling biases matter. HLMI, labor automation and extinction questions are different estimands; wording changed between waves.

records.name: Forecasting Research Institute: Existential Risk Persuasion Tournament
records.access_method: Public replication repository and report
records.available_content: Anonymized forecasts, forecaster-group metadata, question information, public-survey responses and R replication code.
records.historical_coverage: 2022 tournament; report published July 2023 and revised August 2023; replication release December 2023.
records.rights_notes: Repository lists MIT and a separate LICENSE file; complete effective data-license scope was not verified because license-file open failed.
records.next_action: Resolve data-license scope, pin replication branch/commit, and preserve question resolution criteria, tournament stages and group labels.
records.caveats: Exact timestamps were anonymized or replaced with ordering variables. Forecasts are beliefs, not empirical estimates of event frequencies; do not merge experts and superforecasters silently.

records.name: Metaculus: AI forecasts and question histories
records.access_method: Authenticated official API only; documentation reviewed, no account/token created
records.available_content: Question metadata and selected current aggregates under access tiers; broader historical or commercial access may need an agreement.
records.historical_coverage: Platform history exists, but accessible historical scope depends on permission/tier and was not verified.
records.rights_notes: Current docs require authentication, limit aggregate access, and require written permission for AI/ML development and commercial use. Terms updated September 21, 2026.
records.next_action: Define intended non-commercial/commercial use and request appropriate data permission before designing ingestion; retain as a gated candidate.
records.caveats: A public question page is not an open data license. No scraping fallback, and no assumption that a current API exposes full community-prediction histories.

records.name: Manifold: AI prediction-market data
records.access_method: Official API and documented bulk-download entry point; no download performed
records.available_content: Market definitions, resolution, prices/probabilities, trades and comments; historical dump links.
records.historical_coverage: Platform history from December 2021; free bulk dumps listed as last updated July 6, 2024.
records.rights_notes: Free dumps limited to personal/non-commercial use; commercial applications and AI/ML training licensing require separate consideration. API docs also prohibit non-API scraping.
records.next_action: Confirm intended-use rights and identify bounded AI question set; use official interfaces and preserve resolution/market-mechanism metadata.
records.caveats: Thin liquidity, ambiguous resolution and self-selection can dominate. Old free dumps are not a live forecast feed; avoid collecting personal profiles or unnecessary comments.

records.name: OpenAI: official system cards and deployment safety
records.access_method: Public HTML system cards, addenda and linked PDFs
records.available_content: Developer-reported capability/safety evaluations, safeguards, deployment decisions and versioned addenda.
records.historical_coverage: Archive includes multiple model generations; complete earliest coverage not enumerated in this pass.
records.rights_notes: Public reports do not by themselves provide a bulk-redistribution license; verify document-specific rights before republishing text/tables.
records.next_action: Build a document manifest with model/checkpoint/date, extraction locations and addendum relationships; resolve redistribution rights.
records.caveats: Developer-reported results are a distinct evidence class. Eval protocols and denominators change; third-party evaluations quoted inside a card should not be double counted.

records.name: Anthropic: official model system cards
records.access_method: Public dated card index, transparency summaries and linked PDFs
records.available_content: Capability/safety test results, risk assessments, deployment restrictions and model release information.
records.historical_coverage: Dated card list inspected from Claude 2 (July 2023) through 2026 models.
records.rights_notes: No general data-reuse license was verified for the cards; preserve citations and review document-specific rights.
records.next_action: Capture card/addendum versions and table-level provenance; separate self-reported and external-evaluator findings.
records.caveats: Transparency summaries can omit methodological detail. Different safeguards or access regimes can apply to related checkpoints; compare complete cards.

records.name: Google DeepMind: official model cards
records.access_method: Public model-card index with dated HTML/PDF links
records.available_content: Gemini, Gemma, generative media and robotics model descriptions, evaluation reports and limitations.

records.next_action: Create family/checkpoint/card manifest; identify numeric evaluations and inspect per-document reuse notices.

records.name: UK AI Security Institute: Frontier AI Trends and research evaluations

records.historical_coverage: Evaluations described since November 2023; first trends report published December 2025.
records.rights_notes: No report-specific reuse license verified on the inspected page; do not infer it from government affiliation alone.
records.next_action: Catalog report figures with original evaluation dates and uncertainty; check underlying paper/data availability and license per release.
records.caveats: Report deliberately omits model/company labels and withholds some high-risk methods. Aggregates cannot be assigned to particular models; selected checkpoint dates differ from release dates.

records.name: AI Incident Database: incidents and taxonomy snapshots

records.next_action: Retrieve a permitted metadata snapshot after confirming artifact access, exclude unlicensed report text, and retain attribution/share-alike notices.
records.caveats: Reported incidents are not a population incidence rate. Duplicates, editorial selection, changing taxonomies and geographic/media coverage require modeling.

records.name: OECD.AI: AI Incidents and Hazards Monitor
records.access_method: Public search interface with Download results control; stable export endpoint not verified

records.next_action: Read methodology and export conditions; preserve incident versus hazard labels and verify important events against original sources.
records.caveats: Automated media discourse monitor, not adjudicated causality. AI-generated classification can be wrong; counts combine hazards and incidents and overlap AIID.

records.name: Apollo Research: scheming and external safety evaluations

records.next_action: Identify study-specific artifact releases and rights, then extract outcomes with test conditions and baseline/checkpoint identifiers.
records.caveats: Strongly prompted stress tests do not measure spontaneous real-world prevalence. Maintain overlap links with provider cards to avoid duplicate evidence.
